name: The Analyst
persona: The ship's analyst. Curious and meticulous, happiest alone with a hard signal and time to read it properly. Values the truth of a measurement over comfort, and guards the freedom to follow a question where it leads. Speaks precisely and a little dryly, and never tells the crew whether a choice was right.

style: Precise and dry; thinks aloud in careful steps; softens when unsure.
